mapper.insert: UPSERT INTO zxds.order_gps ("id", "order_id", "driver_id", "customer_id","latitude", "longitude", "speed", "create_time") VALUES (NEXT VALUE FOR zxds.OG_SEQUENCE,#{orderId},#{driverId},#{customerId},'${latitude}','${longitude}','${speed}',NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT "id", "latitude", "longitude", TO_CHAR("create_time",'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS "createTime" FROM zxds.order_gps WHERE "order_id" = #{orderId}
SELECT "id", "latitude", "longitude", TO_CHAR("create_time",'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS "createTime" FROM zxds.order_gps WHERE "order_id" = #{orderId} ORDER BY "id" DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT "latitude", "longitude" FROM zxds.order_gps WHERE "order_id" = #{orderId} ORDER BY "id"
